items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: He got people like Bob Graettinger, who is a genius

ctx.x: Kenton was just maybe too progressive for some people I guess, you know.
He got people like Bob Graettinger, who is a genius, absolute genius, but I couldn’t play it on the show, people would throw a stone at me.
Yeah. It was really mixing almost like classical music with the swing type thing.
